claim_text: Микротвёрдость измеряется по методу Виккерса с нагрузкой 0.1-0.5 Н

caveats.text: The claim states 0.1-0.5 N, but the exact standard microhardness range per ISO 6507-1 is 0.09807-1.961 N. The claim's upper bound (0.5 N) is conservative — loads up to ~1 N (100 gf) are also commonly used.
Loads below ~0.05 N (<5 gf) are affected by the indentation size effect (ISE) and are not recommended per ASTM E384.

sources.title: Clarke et al. (2005) Surface & Coatings Technology 194, 283-289
Meka PhD Thesis — Vickers microhardness of nitrided Fe-2at.%Si, load 50 g (0.49 N)
ISO 6507-1:2005 / ГОСТ Р ИСО 6507-1-2007 — Vickers hardness test

reason: Well-supported by local corpus and international standards. Clarke et al. (2005) use 0.098-0.49 N for nitrided AISI 1045. Meka uses 50 g (0.49 N) and 100 mN (0.1 N). ISO 6507-1 defines microhardness range 0.09807-1.961 N. For thin nitrided layers (10-200 μm), 0.1-0.5 N is appropriate.

number_comparison.deviation: Claim range is a subset of the standard microhardness range. No deviation.

fragile_points: The claim does not specify dwell time (typically 10-15 s per ISO 6507)
The claim does not specify that measurements are typically taken on cross-sections
questions_for_author: What specific dwell time was used?
Were measurements taken on cross-sections or on the surface?
